title: Leftover-sized calibration of frozen proxyUhat
question: Is frozen proxyUhat a probability for leftover-sized label translation (A5 m_k), not for planted 1 mm?

y.event: one NEW leftover-sized label translation; endpoints frozen; radial_4
y.t: one draw from that session A5 {m_k}, K=50
y.direction: uniform on the sphere: normalize rng.normal(size=3)
y.rng_order: first integers choice of t index, then 3 normals
y.seed: 2601 + subject_index (A4 Exam B seed; Exam B was never run so no leftover y has been seen)

coverage_bin.rule: highest equal-width bin of proxyUhat with n>=20 on the leftover-y pool

baseline: U-as-P = locked U (already [0,1]); min-max on fit demos is identity
win: ECE(proxyUhat) < ECE(U-as-P) on leftover y AND the highest occupied bin (n>=20) has |mean_y - mean_P| <= 0.15
fail: any miss. Keep U. Ensemble leftover mm remain measurements. Not proxy-hat{U}. Not hat{U}.
